speaker: john_heminges
text: Errors is done. Set the leaf by the candle. I am not counting a share onto it, and I am not opening a coffer to make a Saturday feel finished.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then read me the week, if the money is to be a silence. I can spend a week. I have spent silences, and they pay badly.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Monday, Titus, at two. Will is in it. Tuesday, rehearsal at nine, and Fair Em at two. He is in Fair Em.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Wednesday, Titus, at two. Not him. Thursday, rehearsal at nine, and the Seven Deadly Sins at two. He is in the Sins.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Friday, Fair Em, at two. Not him. Saturday, the Seven Deadly Sins again. Him. That is the week. I am not adding a play because the hill was handsome.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Say it back, Will, before Saturday grows an eighth afternoon out of a nod.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday Titus, me. Tuesday the nine o'clock, and Fair Em, me. Wednesday Titus, not me. Thursday the nine o'clock, and the Seven Deadly Sins, me. Friday Fair Em, not me. Saturday the Sins, me. I have it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The Rose today was the first Caesar. We were in Errors. We did not go, and I am not giving their title a second life on our leaf.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Candlemas is tomorrow. This is the hour when a man pretends the letter is already sealed. Are we pretending?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The packet is not written. I am not setting anything beside the horn tonight. Tomorrow is the twins' day. I am not spending it on a Saturday to be rid of it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Edith's eight shillings is still owing till Lady Day. The Queen's twenty pound is still not had. I am not inventing a third sum to fill a gap.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The two boys are three shillings the week each. Not paid out of this parlour. A promise is not a coin, and their mothers know it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And the gown. Thou hast not bought it, John. The Princess wants a gown, and a gown is not a sentence.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I have not been to the mercer. She may want it, and Cheapside can wait until I am standing in it with a reason. Tonight I have a leaf, and the leaf has no gown on it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: No share, no coffer, no gown, no packet. You are a severe clerk, John. The barges were gayer, and they were not ours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A student played a prince and the guns agreed with him. We do it for a penny and are rogues by statute. I said it on the hill. I am not asking the Tower to revise us.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I have the tucket. I am not humming it over a reckoning. John's leaf is enough music.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Augustine steals a trumpet and John steals nothing, not even a shilling of show. I admire the two thefts at different prices.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Tomorrow is church, and his letter if he writes it. I have no play to set on a Sunday. The week I read is the week.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sentence at home is still unsent. A week on a leaf is not the day I owe Anne. I do not yet know that day.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Go home, then. Thou hast had a prince, a play, and a leaf with no sum. That is a full Saturday. Do not improve it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The first Caesar can keep his bank. I am for my supper, and for no new number.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I am for mine. You, Master Shakespeare, have the look of a man who will touch a pen and call it not writing. I will not stay to argue the definition.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: If I touch a pen tonight it will not be the packet. The hill was the once of the year. I am not going back to better the view.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then once more, and I shut the leaf. No share. No coffer. The boys unpaid. Edith's eight shillings owing. The twenty pound not had. The gown not bought.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Once is enough. Shut it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The tucket stays with me. Good night.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Good night. A lean leaf and a fat river. I know which one I shall remember, and John knows which one he can enter. They are not the same.
